title: Fixed assets without depreciation and inactive CIP
prompt: Which fixed assets have been placed in service but have no depreciation recorded, and which construction-in-progress items have been inactive for more than 90 days?

setup.q: Which accounts hold construction in progress?

inputs.name: Fixed asset register kept outside Dime

steps: list fixed assets with in-service dates and the depreciation schedule rows for the period
flag in-service assets with no depreciation posted
pull the CIP accounts' ledgers and find items with no activity in 90 days
write the workbook with cost, dates and last activity per row

done.text: Every exception row cites the asset id or the CIP transaction id
fixed-asset-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Inactive CIP items are listed as inactive, never assumed ready for use
